import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_97/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_97/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_97/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_97/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_97/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_97/training_5.csv"
]

# Columns of the target schema in order and their types (for reference)
target_columns = [
    'adm0_name',  # string
    'adm1_name',  # string
    'mkt_name',   # string
    'cm_name',    # string
    'cur_name',   # string
    'pt_name',    # string
    'um_id',      # integer
    'um_name',    # string
    'mp_month',   # integer
    'mp_year',    # integer
    'mp_price',   # float
    'Year'        # float
]

# Load all source dataframes with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# According to operation history: UNION all source tables
# All source tables have the same schema (except Source4 is empty but same columns)
# So we can concat them directly

# Concatenate all dataframes
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the target schema order (except 'Year' which is not in source)
# The source columns are:
# ['adm0_name', 'adm1_name', 'mkt_name', 'cm_name', 'cur_name', 'pt_name', 'um_id', 'um_name', 'mp_month', 'mp_year', 'mp_price']

# Reorder columns to match target except 'Year' which we will add next
combined_df = combined_df[target_columns[:-1]]

# Convert types to match target schema:
# 'um_id' and 'mp_month', 'mp_year' should be integer
# 'mp_price' float
# 'Year' float (to be computed)
# Some source data might have these as float or int, so enforce types carefully

combined_df['um_id'] = combined_df['um_id'].astype(int)
combined_df['mp_month'] = combined_df['mp_month'].astype(int)
combined_df['mp_year'] = combined_df['mp_year'].astype(int)
combined_df['mp_price'] = combined_df['mp_price'].astype(float)

# Compute 'Year' column as float: Year + (Month-1)/12
combined_df['Year'] = combined_df['mp_year'] + (combined_df['mp_month'] - 1) / 12

# Reorder columns to final target schema order including 'Year'
combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_97/target_multisource.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
